rtshop.pvp.outside_off: PvP outside town: not allowed. Players can use /pvp on only inside PvP zones.
rtshop.pvp.pos1: First corner: x %s, z %s  (go to the opposite corner and run /rtshop pvp pos2)
rtshop.pvp.pos2: Second corner: x %s, z %s  (now /rtshop pvp zone add <name> — add 'safe' for a safe zone)
rtshop.pvp.need_pos: First run /rtshop pvp pos1 and /rtshop pvp pos2 at two corners. (or /rtshop pvp zone here <name> <radius>)
rtshop.pvp.zone_unknown: No zone named '%s'. (/rtshop pvp zone list)
rtshop.pvp.zone_none: No zones yet. (/rtshop pvp pos1 → pos2 → zone add <name>)
rtshop.pvp.show_on: Showing zone borders (red = PvP, green = safe, white = selection). Run again to hide.
rtshop.restaurant.empty: No dishes on the menu yet. Each dish a cook sells to the restaurant owner is added to the menu.
rtshop.restaurant.cook_only: Only players with the cook job can sell dishes to the restaurant owner. (Anyone can buy.)
rtshop.restaurant.sell_note: Includes the +%s%% restaurant bonus (the cook bonus is added separately)
rtshop.restaurant.new_menu: [Restaurant] Cook %s added a new dish to the menu: %s! (menu %s/%s)
rtshop.restaurant.cmd_status: Restaurant: menu %s/%s · sell bonus +%s%% · job allowed to sell: %s
rtshop.restaurant.cmd_off: The restaurant is disabled or its source shop is missing. (config/rtshop/restaurant.json)
rtshop.restaurant.cmd_reset: The restaurant menu was cleared (%s dishes).
rtshop.restaurant.cmd_unlock_all: All dishes are now on the menu (%s new).
rtshop.restaurant.cmd_unknown: Not a dish the restaurant handles: %s
rtshop.plot.bought_cleared: The crops and structures on the lot were cleared (%s blocks). Farmland and water channels are kept.
item.rtshop.raid_ticket.tip1: Used (one per entry) when you enter the weekly raid through the raid guide.
item.rtshop.raid_eye.tip1: Use it on the altar in the middle of the raid arena to wake the raid boss.
item.rtshop.raid_eye.tip2: It disappears when you leave the raid arena.
item.rtshop.raid_escape.tip1: Right-click inside the raid arena to return to town at any time.
item.rtshop.raid_escape.tip2: If nobody is left in the arena the boss disappears (it does not count as a kill).
rtshop.raid.ui_locked: The boss is awake, the gate is closed · %s inside
rtshop.redit.empty: No rewards in this group. Hold an item and press [Add held item].
rtshop.redit.hint: Click a value to edit, then press [Save]
rtshop.quest.job_busy: You are already doing the %s job quests. Abandon that quest in your quest book to switch (one combat and one life job line at a time).
rtshop.quest.job_paused: You stopped this job's quest line. You can now take another job's quests (you'll resume where you left off if you come back).
item.rtshop.undying_ember.desc1: An ember handed over by a burning knight in a dream.
item.rtshop.undying_ember.desc2: It is warm in the hand, like someone's body heat.
item.rtshop.undying_ember.desc3: "Someday it will be yours to guard."
item.rtshop.chronicle_page.desc1: Old paper with the mark of a blade along its edge.
item.rtshop.frost_heart.desc1: The cold crystal Frostmaw slept holding.
item.rtshop.frost_heart.desc2: Ice that calms fire. Do not sell it.
item.rtshop.oath_scroll.desc2: Proof that you are an apprentice of the Order of Embers.
rtshop.economy.death_story_boss: You fell fighting a story boss. You kept your Gold.
rtshop.msg.story_locked: This gear unlocks after finishing %s of the main story.
rtshop.qedit.hint_structure: -> done inside the structure (e.g. minecraft:desert_pyramid, #minecraft:ruined_portal, cataclysm:*)
rtshop.qedit.hint_advancement: -> done when the advancement is earned (e.g. minecraft:nether/root)
rtshop.qedit.hint_dimension: -> done on entering the dimension (e.g. minecraft:the_nether)
rtshop.qedit.hint_flag: -> done once the flag is held (e.g. abyss_floor_2 = Spiral Abyss floor 2)
item.rtshop.scylla_clue.desc1: It smells faintly of a storm.
item.rtshop.scylla_clue.desc2: Use: record · Sneak+use: notebook · Hold and talk to a villager: ask
rtshop.scylla.complete: The five pieces fit into one logbook: the Log of the Welcome. Lightning sears its last page, and the storm eye is left in your hand.
rtshop.hunt.job_bonus_on: Combat job bonus +%s%% active · new bounties daily at 6 AM
rtshop.hunt.job_bonus_off: +%s%% with a combat job · new bounties daily at 6 AM
rtshop.hunt.click_book: Click to see this chapter's mobs
rtshop.job.confirm_body: Its buffs and debuffs apply at once. Changing later costs Gold and has a cooldown.
rtshop.job.confirm_change_body: Costs %s G. Your current job's buffs and debuffs end.
rtshop.quest.job_has: You already have the %s job, so you can't take another job's quests. Leave your job at the job guide first.
rtshop.talk.default_greet: What can I do for you?
rtshop.quest.next_same: There's more to tell. Talk to me again. ("%s")
rtshop.hunt.board_far: Talk to the town clerk to see the bounty board.
rtshop.hunt.board_full: You cannot take more of these.
rtshop.hunt.none_taken: No bounties taken. Pick some at the town clerk's bounty board.
rtshop.arena.won: The boss has fallen. You return shortly; its drops go to your bag.
rtshop.arena.unknown: This boss cannot be fought beyond the Memory Gate.
rtshop.arena.no_quest: Only while a quest asks you to defeat this boss.
rtshop.arena.already: You are already beyond the Memory Gate.
rtshop.arena.full: All Memory Gates are in use. Try again shortly.
item.rtshop.mother_journal.desc1: The last journal of an archivist who vanished fifteen years ago.
item.rtshop.mother_journal.desc2: Last page: "It was a hand, not fire, that cut the chronicle."
item.rtshop.mother_journal.desc3: A grey thread is caught on the corner.
item.rtshop.grey_coin.desc1: A coin of no kingdom. The bounty on chronicle pages.
item.rtshop.grey_coin.desc2: A cloaked figure is stamped on the back.
item.rtshop.old_expedition_map.desc1: Found in the pack of the pillager captain Kass.
item.rtshop.old_expedition_map.desc2: Twelve red marks. Only one is crossed out.
item.rtshop.old_expedition_map.desc3: Signed in the corner: Loran, Kael.
item.rtshop.expedition_tag.desc1: The iron plate of a member who never came back, twenty years ago.
item.rtshop.expedition_tag.desc2: Captain Loran takes each one back.
item.rtshop.broken_sun_mask.desc1: The Umvuthana mask Kael wore for twenty years.
item.rtshop.broken_sun_mask.desc2: Twelve names scratched inside with a fingernail.
item.rtshop.broken_sun_mask.desc3: "It wasn't the captain who froze the sea."
item.rtshop.crew_name_tag.desc1: A name tag of Cornelia's crew, pulled from the ice maze.
item.rtshop.crew_name_tag.desc2: Oscar the fisher reads each name aloud.
item.rtshop.frozen_logbook.desc2: "A scholar in a grey cloak sold the route."
item.rtshop.frozen_logbook.desc3: "The crew's souls were dragged to the city where sound dies."
item.rtshop.grey_ash.desc1: Ash left by the grey smoke that slipped out as Ignis went dark.
item.rtshop.grey_ash.desc3: Somewhere in the ash, someone is laughing.
item.rtshop.memory_shard.desc1: A piece of Erwin's memory, dropped by a mob the Wither had possessed.
item.rtshop.memory_shard.desc2: Hold it and a disciple's voice from a thousand years ago speaks.
item.rtshop.chronicle_last_page.desc1: The last page of the Ashen Chronicle, blank for a thousand years.
item.rtshop.chronicle_last_page.desc2: Now your story is written on it.
item.rtshop.chronicle_last_page.desc3: "We kept the fire, kept the seal, and let go."
item.rtshop.survey_compass.desc1: Use it to learn the direction and distance of the place your quest is looking for.
item.rtshop.survey_compass.desc2: Standard storm-survey gear. The needle sometimes points at the southern sky.
item.rtshop.survey_compass.none: None of your quests is looking for a place.
item.rtshop.survey_compass.far: %s: nothing nearby. Travel further and try again.
rtshop.hunt.pool_added: Added to the bounty list: %s (from the next day; /bounty pool reroll to see it now)
rtshop.hunt.pool_missing: %s is not on the bounty list.
rtshop.scylla.waiting: Every clue is gathered, yet the storm does not call you. Not until the chronicle's last page is written…
rtshop.staged.unlocked: ✦ A new place of the story begins to appear somewhere in the world. (Look in lands not yet explored)
rtshop.staged.title: Staged story structures (%s)
rtshop.void.rescued: ✦ Before the void could take you, the ember pulled you back to the last ground you stood on.
rtshop.jedit.classes_hint: Comma separated · kinds: sword, axe, bow, crossbow, trident, ranged, tool
rtshop.jedit.items_none: No items fall into this type.
rtshop.jedit.items_hint: Click a type to move just that item (save to apply)
rtshop.gacha.inventory_full: Not enough free inventory space: %1$s pulls need %1$s free slots (you have %2$s). Make room and try again.
item.rtshop.undying_ember.guide: A token from the dream knight. No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.oath_scroll.guide: Proof of your apprenticeship. No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.chronicle_page.guide: Collected as the main story goes on. No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.mother_journal.guide: No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.grey_coin.guide: No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.old_expedition_map.guide: No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.expedition_tag.guide: No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.broken_sun_mask.guide: No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.frozen_logbook.guide: No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.grey_ash.guide: No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.chronicle_last_page.guide: Proof that you finished the main story. No quest takes this; keep it as a memento of the story.
item.rtshop.crew_name_tag.guide: Hand 2 to Oscar the Fisher in the quest "Call Their Names". Do not drop or sell them.
item.rtshop.memory_shard.guide: Hand 3 to Oscar the Fisher in the quest "The Apprentice of a Thousand Years Ago". Do not drop or sell them.
item.rtshop.frost_heart.guide: Hand 1 to Expedition Captain Loran in the quest "The Archivist Taken". Do not drop or sell it.
item.rtshop.scylla_clue.guide: They say something opens once enough are recorded. Do not throw it away.
item.rtshop.survey_compass.desc3: Only points to places that really exist, at least 1000 blocks from town.
rtshop.itemstats.title: Equipment Stats
rtshop.itemstats.no_item: Pick an item ('Other item' below, or hold one and run /rtshop itemstats).
rtshop.itemstats.hint: Empty = original. Type the number shown in the tooltip (damage 8, speed 1.6).
rtshop.itemstats.slot.head: Head
rtshop.itemstats.saved: Saved the stats of %s. They apply to everyone right away.
block.rtshop.arcane_orb.tip1: Right-click: magic gacha (skill books · enchant reroll)
block.rtshop.arcane_orb.tip2: Magic tickets are sold at the gacha ticket shop.
item.rtshop.magic_ticket.tip: Draws one skill book from any field (Starlight Crystal Orb).
item.rtshop.magic_ticket_select.tip: Draws a skill book from the field you choose: attack, guard, dodge, passive or mobility.
item.rtshop.enchant_scroll.tip: Clears the held weapon's enchantments and puts one new enchantment on it.
rtshop.magic.title: Starlight Crystal Orb · Magic Gacha
rtshop.magic.random_desc: Draws one of %s skill books from every field. Cheaper.
rtshop.magic.reroll_desc: Clears the held weapon's enchantments and adds one new enchantment.
rtshop.magic.reroll_hold: Hold the weapon to reroll, then open the window.
rtshop.magic.reroll_bad_item: The held item cannot be rerolled (one weapon only).
rtshop.magic.need_orb: Use it near the Starlight Crystal Orb.
rtshop.magic.empty: This draw has no prizes yet (OP: Auto-fill in the editor).
rtshop.magic.edit_odds_head: Odds per grade (used as ratios; grades without prizes are skipped)
rtshop.magic.edit_empty: Empty. Add below or press Auto-fill.
rtshop.magic.saved: Magic gacha settings saved and applied.
rtshop.magic.autofilled: Rebuilt the lists: %s skill books, %s enchantments.
rtshop.magic.pity_hit: Pity reached! A guaranteed grade came.
rtshop.magic.edit_pity_head: Pity: if the grade has not come by the set count, that draw is guaranteed
rtshop.magic.edit_bless_head: Today's rune: each period one field is blessed and its chosen draw gets better
rtshop.magic.edit_bless_note: The discount applies to the ticket count (rounded up, at least 1). At 1 per draw it shows on 10× draws. ×1 = odds unchanged.

rtshop.magic.tip.unchoose: Touch again to go back to random

rtshop.magic.locked: The mirror shows nothing. It is not time yet.
rtshop.spot.appeared: Something nearby is worth a closer look: %s
rtshop.spot.appeared_plain: There is a trace nearby worth a closer look.

rtshop.rite.sleeping: The dragon sleeps on the pedestal, hard as stone. Place crystals on its four sides to wake it.
rtshop.notebook.title: Field Notebook
rtshop.notebook.empty: Nothing examined yet. Traces you look at during story quests are written down here.
item.rtshop.antidote.tip: Drink to cure poison, wither and hunger.
